description: Data foundation: period helpers, lazy non-destructive migration in the Store, and period-aware model calculations. This feature introduces member.periods['YYYY-Qn'] = { scores, plan } and makes reads/writes migrate legacy members transparently and idempotently, while making all Model calculations resolve scores from a given periodKey with retrocompat fallback. It touches NO UI; the app must still load and behave as before (reading the current quarter) after this feature. Independent of later features in that it builds and runs standalone, but FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: In js/store.js (module scope, near norm/emailToId), add helpers: `function periodKeyFor(date){ const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + '-Q' + (Math.floor(d.getMonth()/3)+1); }` and `function currentPeriodKey(){ return periodKeyFor(new Date()); }`. periodKey format is 'YYYY-Qn', Q1=Jan-Mar..Q4=Oct-Dec.

In js/store.js, add `function migrateOnRead(member){ if(!member) return member; if(!member.periods){ member.periods = {}; member.periods[currentPeriodKey()] = { scores: member.scores || {}, plan: member.plan || [] }; } return member; }` — idempotent: when member.periods already exists it is left untouched. It does NOT delete legacy root scores/plan (safe on pure reads). Add a Portuguese comment explaining the lazy, non-destructive migration contract.

In js/store.js, add `function prepareForWrite(member, mode){ migrateOnRead(member); const payload = Object.assign({}, member); if(mode === 'firebase'){ payload.scores = firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete(); payload.plan = firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete(); } else { delete payload.scores; delete payload.plan; } return payload; }`. Rationale comment: Firebase save uses {merge:true}, so stale root fields must be explicitly deleted with FieldValue.delete(); local mode just omits them.

Wire migrateOnRead into LocalStore.list (return this._read().map(migrateOnRead)) and into the Firebase store.list (map both the leader branch snap.docs and the single-collaborator-doc branch through migrateOnRead).

Wire prepareForWrite into LocalStore.save (store the migrated member via _write but persist the stripped payload — keep LocalStore._read/_write consistent; simplest: migrateOnRead(member) then build a stripped copy with delete payload.scores/payload.plan before writing to localStorage) and into the Firebase store.save (await col.doc(member.id).set(prepareForWrite(member,'firebase'), { merge: true })). In local mode make sure the object pushed back by callers still reflects periods (migrateOnRead mutates member in place, so app.js's in-memory member gains periods).

Expose helpers: window.Store.currentPeriodKey = currentPeriodKey; window.Store.periodKeyFor = periodKeyFor; (set after window.Store is assigned, alongside the existing isBootstrapLeader/emailToId/normEmail exposures).

In js/model.js, add `function periodScores(member, periodKey){ if(member && member.periods && periodKey && member.periods[periodKey] && member.periods[periodKey].scores) return member.periods[periodKey].scores; return (member && member.scores) || {}; }` with a comment noting the retrocompat fallback to legacy top-level scores.

In js/model.js, change signatures to accept periodKey and resolve via periodScores: pillarAverage(member, pillar, periodKey) uses periodScores(member,periodKey)[pillar.id]; memberScoresByCompetency(member, pillar, periodKey) likewise; teamAverageByCompetency(members, pillar, excludeId, periodKey) uses periodScores(m,periodKey)?.[pillar.id]?.[comp] for each other member; weightedAxis(member, weights, periodKey) passes periodKey to pillarAverage; performanceScore(member, periodKey) and potentialScore(member, periodKey) pass periodKey through; nineBoxCell(member, periodKey) and nineBoxLabel(member, periodKey) pass periodKey to performance/potential. Add periodScores to the window.Model export object.

Do NOT change app.js yet in this feature; because callers pass undefined periodKey for now, periodScores must fall back to legacy member.scores so the app keeps working. Verify this fallback explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: js/store.js and js/model.js load with no console SyntaxError/ReferenceError (balanced braces/parens/backticks).
Store.currentPeriodKey() returns a string matching /^\d{4}-Q[1-4]$/ consistent with the current date.

A legacy member object run through the store read path gains member.periods[currentPeriodKey()] = { scores, plan } equal to its original top-level scores/plan, and legacy root fields remain present in memory until a save.
A member that already has .periods is returned unchanged by the read path (idempotent).
With periodKey undefined, Model.pillarAverage(member, pillar) returns the same value it returned before this change for a member whose scores are at the top level (retrocompat fallback).
verification: Open http://localhost:8080 and confirm the app loads with no console errors and all existing views (Time, Avaliação, Nine Box, Plano, Usuários, Tutorial) still render.
In the DevTools console: confirm /^\d{4}-Q[1-4]$/.test(Store.currentPeriodKey()) === true.

In the console, create a legacy member literal `{id:'x', scores:{hard:{'Cloud / AWS':4}}, plan:[]}` and confirm the store read path (or a direct call to the migrate helper if exposed) produces periods[Store.currentPeriodKey()].scores.hard['Cloud / AWS'] === 4.
Confirm Model.periodScores and the updated calc signatures exist on window.Model.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED in js/store.js and js/model.js (no changes to app.js/index.html/styles.css/firebase-config.js/firestore.rules).

PERIOD KEY FORMAT: 'YYYY-Qn' where Q1=Jan-Mar, Q2=Abr-Jun, Q3=Jul-Set, Q4=Out-Dez. Derived as year + '-Q' + (Math.floor(month/3)+1).

STORE (js/store.js) new module-scope helpers (near emailToId):
- periodKeyFor(date) -> string. Accepts a Date (defaults to new Date() if not a Date instance).
- currentPeriodKey() -> string for today.
- migrateOnRead(member) -> member. Idempotent, non-destructive, mutates IN PLACE. If member has no .periods, creates member.periods[currentPeriodKey()] = { scores: member.scores||{}, plan: member.plan||[] }. Does NOT delete legacy root scores/plan. Returns member unchanged if .periods already exists. Returns falsy member untouched.
- prepareForWrite(member, mode) -> payload. Calls migrateOnRead first; shallow-copies member; for mode==='firebase' sets payload.scores/payload.plan = firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete(); otherwise (local) deletes those keys from the copy. Returns the strip payload (original member keeps root fields in memory).

STORE WIRING:
- LocalStore.list(): returns this._read().map(migrateOnRead).
- LocalStore.save(member): payload = prepareForWrite(member,'local'); upserts payload by id into localStorage; returns the original (now-migrated) member so callers' in-memory object has .periods.
- Firebase store.list(): leader branch and single-doc branch both map through migrateOnRead.
- Firebase store.save(member): col.doc(member.id).set(prepareForWrite(member,'firebase'), { merge: true }); returns member.

EXPOSED ON window.Store (added after assignment, alongside isBootstrapLeader/emailToId/normEmail): window.Store.currentPeriodKey, window.Store.periodKeyFor.

MODEL (js/model.js):
- NEW: periodScores(member, periodKey) -> scores object. Returns member.periods[periodKey].scores when present; else RETROCOMPAT fallback to member.scores || {}. With periodKey undefined it always falls back to legacy top-level scores, so existing UI calls behave exactly as before.
- UPDATED SIGNATURES (periodKey appended as last param, resolved via periodScores):
  * pillarAverage(member, pillar, periodKey)
  * teamAverageByCompetency(members, pillar, excludeId, periodKey)
  * memberScoresByCompetency(member, pillar, periodKey)
  * weightedAxis(member, weights, periodKey)
  * performanceScore(member, periodKey)
  * potentialScore(member, periodKey)
  * nineBoxCell(member, periodKey)
  * nineBoxLabel(member, periodKey)
- window.Model export now includes periodScores (in addition to all prior exports). band/compNames unchanged.

FOR LATER FEATURES (FEAT-002/003): read scores for a quarter via Model.periodScores(member, periodKey) or pass periodKey through the calc functions. Current quarter = Store.currentPeriodKey(). To iterate available quarters use Object.keys(member.periods||{}). Writes must go through Store.save(member) after setting member.periods[key].scores/plan; Store.save strips the legacy root scores/plan automatically. app.js currently passes undefined periodKey everywhere (unchanged in this feature), relying on the retrocompat fallback.

VERIFICATION: caddy served the worktree root on :8080; index.html, js/store.js, js/model.js all returned HTTP 200. Brace/paren balance confirmed (store.js 75/75 braces, 189/189 parens; model.js 61/61 braces, 73/73 parens; no backticks). No node/headless browser available in this env, so the in-browser console checks (regex on currentPeriodKey, migrate helper on a legacy literal) were validated by code inspection rather than executed.
